At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Manufacturing Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 202745

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Verify designs of new modules/products/changes and analyze design for manufacturing.

 * Combine BOM strategy with manufacturing line

 * Review design solutions in terms of safety, ergonomics, tooling, Form-Fit-Function

 * Create Work Instructions and production process steps

 * Implement cost-efficient methods of assembly for all phases of manufacturing.

 * Implement non standard customer requests onto products and transfer to manufacturing

 * Support to transfer new products into high volume manufacturing.

 * Work closely with suppliers and remote factories (including traveling)

 * Implement new ideas and defining new ways of processes to reduce costs and assembly time

 * Continuous Improvement for products, process and manufacturing

WHO WE RE LOKKING FOR

 * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of experience; or equivalent experience (Technical education/HTL Electrical/Mechatronic)

 * Skilled troubleshooting capabilities in the areas of electro/mechanical assemblies

 * Experience on lean manufacturing and Design for Manufacturing methodologies preferred

 * Hands on experience with CAD, NX or similar tools

 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

 * MS office & SAP skills preferred

 * Self managed and proactive working style

 * Ability to travel to suppliers or other Lam locations

COMPENSATION

This position will be occupied in Villach. OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it! 1 Product Manager - Construction & Real Estate (PropTech) (m/f/d) Job description
We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * Pricing and packaging. You align packaging with sales, keep the unit economics of compute-intensive simulation runs healthy, and own the Stripe catalog end-to-end.

 * Discovery and delivery with customers. You run pilot projects, sit down with asset managers and engineers, translate what you hear into specs, and make sure the platform's reports and studies hold up with customers.

 * Quality standards for simulation results. Engineers have to trust the numbers. You define, per engine, what "good enough to ship" means, and you manage the trade-off between physical accuracy and product speed.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

Your profile

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

 * Real technical confidence. You question a data model, follow a discussion with engineers, and understand a simulation output well enough to challenge it.

 * A degree that connects building energy systems, simulation, and building operations across engineering disciplines - or equivalent hands-on competence in building analysis and simulation

 * Fluent English; professional German strongly preferred.

Why us?

 * Real impact. Your product decisions feed into real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - a complete product portfolio rather than isolated one-off projects.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option & a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000.00 - €80,000.00 gross/year.
